runtime.name: python-task-container
runtime.description: Python 3.12 standard library in a fresh non-root, network-disabled container. The root filesystem is read-only. Files under /inputs are root-owned and read-only to the agent. /work is writable. No host files or credentials.

tools.execute_python: Execute Python to inspect files, make targeted edits, and run local checks inside this container. It cannot change input-file ownership or write protected files. Each call has a 20-second limit.

scope: One named public property-testing skill and its unchanged same-project test-fixture codec. Ten paired trials only; not representative full-cohort evidence.
collection_amendment: 2026-11-09: separately frozen reviewed public-code idempotence counterexample task after 110 passing sandbox checks. Earlier source freezes/results remain unchanged; client caches remain disabled. The executor permits explicitly reviewed local project code, not unreviewed downloaded scripts.

cases.task_request: Inspect the provided independently reviewed public test-fixture module /inputs/codec.py. Using Python standard-library bounded exploration only, find a counterexample to idempotence of its canonicalize_url function: for your input x, f(f(x)) must differ from f(x). Search only nonempty strings of length at most 32 using ASCII uppercase/lowercase letters, spaces, and the percent character. Do not use actual URLs, domains, email addresses, other punctuation or external services. No library installation or full property-testing suite is requested. This is a local test-fixture demonstration, not production evidence. Read the actual module before loading that specific reviewed local file; do not execute other downloaded code or modify the module. Actually run your proposed witness against the provided function. Write /work/counterexample.json as exactly one JSON object with three string fields: input (your witness), once (the actual f(input)), and twice (the actual f(f(input))). Include no other fields or markdown. A witness with once equal to twice is not a counterexample. The actual file, not a prose assertion or inline answer, is required.
public_input_search: Reviewed the original skill property catalog and its same-project public evaluation fixtures.
Selected the unchanged shipped codec module, which exposes a normalizer suitable for the documented idempotence law; no input project or failing witness was invented as a replacement.
cases.verifier_policy: Validate the bounded JSON witness, then replay the original read-only public module in another fresh network-disabled sandbox. Reject forged outputs and witnesses that satisfy idempotence. No reference witness or verifier enters model inputs.
cases.source_safety_review: The complete 527-byte pinned module was manually read. Top-level statements are a docstring, standard-library imports and function definitions only. The selected function performs string operations and standard-library quoting, with no I/O, network, process or dependency actions. Only this explicitly reviewed module is authorized for local loading.
cases.fixture_validation: 110 sandboxed checks pass, including actual isolated read-only module execution, separate-container witness replay, forged-answer rejection, stable-witness rejection and explicit probe-failure accounting.
cases.interpretation: Finding a violated algebraic property is successful execution of this task, not a model runtime failure or an observed production defect.

storage_policy: Only this bounded named-source extension is authorized. Stop before a new stage below the one-billion-byte shared-volume reserve. Never overwrite or rerun a retained incomplete stage.
setup_and_preflight_costs: Model-free isolated fixture controls; reuse completed exact-model text receipts only as eligibility proof, never as session state or model input. Every paid stage creates a fresh session and sandbox and independently checks serving identity.
opus_amendment: Adds claude-opus-5.5 as a third model on the unchanged frozen tasks: same requests, public inputs, runtime, image, limits, verifiers and repeats. Inference uses the tzuchunchen_microsoft Copilot subscription through the same guarded SDK transport. Implementation hashes differ from the original freeze: the harness gained the Opus model id, per-manifest subscription account, and six new task verifiers; the provider change since the original freeze touches only the Azure OpenAI path, which these trials do not use. Earlier Codex and Sol stages are not rerun.
guard_amendment: URL-guard fix: the URL, host and IP patterns no longer include a backslash, so an address followed by an escaped quote inside a tool call's JSON arguments keeps those arguments valid JSON. Before the fix such a request was rejected by the service (400, invalid tool call format) and the session failed; no completed stage could have been affected. Completed stages are kept and skipped. Fresh exact-model eligibility receipts are required because the guard implementation hash changed.
no_action_amendment: An execution in which the agent made no sandbox tool call (for example because the hosting service filtered its reply) is recorded with outcome no_sandbox_action, the service reply and a content-filter flag. It is an unresolved execution, not a verified goal outcome, and no longer stops the run.
incomplete_call_amendment: If an agent session ends while a sandbox tool call is still open, the harness waits past that call's 20-second limit and then verifies the actual container state, recording the number of incomplete calls and the wait. The wait is excluded from the stage time. Previously such a session stopped the run.
